faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Shipping, returns and choosing the right size — the answers pet parents ask for most.

items.question: Where do you ship?
items.answer: We currently ship across Spain and France, with the rest of the EU rolling out soon. Delivery is free on orders over €80.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Orders are prepared within 1–2 business days and typically arrive in 3–6 business days with tracked delivery.

items.question: What is the return window?
items.answer: 30 days from delivery, unused and in its original packaging. See our refund policy for the full terms.

items.question: How do I choose the right size?
items.answer: See our pet care & sizing guide. If your pet is between two sizes, size up for beds and carriers.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Sign in and open My orders — every order has a detail page with live tracking links.
